title: Don't hesitate to reserve this tour!
text: Jorge brought the ruins to life!  He was very informative, personable, and portrayed  Emporer Hadrian beautifully!  My husband is a retired History teacher and was impressed also!  Sure, the public can explore the ruins, and read the signs, but he offered more in-depth information.  The tortilla after the tour was delicious (we were not familiar with the dish-thinking of a flat, flour tortilla) and we enjoyed speaking with him.  The pick-up and drop offs were so helpful!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!  Don't hesitate to reserve this tour.
author: madsanrd

title: If I could give this tour ten stars, I absolutely would!
text: Our group included three adults and one six-year-old, and “Hadrian” led us on an unforgettable journey through history. He stayed fully in character the entire time, which made the experience even more immersive. Out of all the private tours we took in Seville, this was by far our favorite. The guide was not only a talented actor but also impressively knowledgeable about the era.
author: Linda_F

title: The Emperor Spoke - and did it well!
text: The Roman Emperor was very knowledgeable about his town. Funny, engaging, with stories from the time. I highly recommend this tour!
author: Larry_L

title: Best tour ever!
text: This was a wonderful tour!  We were picked up within a few minutes’ walk of our cruise ship and driven to Italica, where Jorge, ie Caesar, was waiting for us.  The tour was entertaining, humorous, and informative.  We were treated to a delightful Spanish lunch following the tour.  I highly recommend!
author: Amanda_L

title: Thanks Adriano!!
text: Highly recommended for both adults and children. Getting to know Itálica from the hand of this particular Adriano has been a piece of experience.
author: jloliosq

title: An interesting and fun visit! Jorge is wonderful!
text: Although I had already visited Itálica several times, none was as enjoyable, interesting and fun as the one we did with Jorge. A journey through the history of the Roman Empire, with its unique touch of humor. We loved it and recommend it without a doubt!
author: 980nurial

title: Guided tour of Itálica With Adriano
text: It was a great experience. We were a group of friends with many children and Jorge made it super entertaining. It offers you a different visit with many anecdotes and data about Itálica. The children were delighted. And the adults too.
author: LPAC7

title: Great for kids and adults!
text: Absolutely amazing with kids and adults! The Perfect combination of adult humor (over the kids’ heads, while absolutely captivating kids of all ages. So much information and a perfect way to learn about and experience this amazing sight. THANK YOU!!!
author: alexandracR1633QA

title: Return to live Roman history
text: The experience of this tour in Itálica was surprising; for the historical place visited and for the enjoyable, fun and educational nature of the entire activity. I went with my partner and although both he and I are used to visiting many places, he was fascinated by this tour because it was different and out of the ordinary among what is offered to us tourists. In addition to spending a few very pleasant hours, it ends with a typical Spanish pincho and a wine to celebrate. author: Matilde L

title: Highly recommended
text: Incredible, a unique experience. Highly recommended. It's interesting and fun. Then we were talking to Jorge and he treated us very well.
